name: Scale
scope: event bus envelope and ordering contract

architecture.runtime: existing Phase 2 runtime remains the execution owner
architecture.authority: Phase 4 Trust Kernel remains the authority boundary
architecture.tools: Phase 5 Tool Fabric remains the tool execution owner
architecture.isolation: Phase 7 Isolation Fabric remains the environment boundary
architecture.evidence: Phase 8 Evidence Fabric remains the provenance/audit owner
architecture.investigation: Phase 10 consumes evidence; Scale does not replace it

distributed_invariants: stale workers are fenced by monotonically increasing lease tokens
event sequence numbers are contiguous per tenant/topic/partition
idempotency keys cannot be reused for a different request digest
region selection fails closed when the region set is invalid
workers never receive new authority from the scheduler
reference_backend_note: In-memory lease/event/idempotency/workflow stores are deterministic reference implementations; production multi-worker deployments require shared durable infrastructure.
